utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m still catching up, but I can help once I’m there. What’s left to fix, and should I check in with Hana or Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — could you check in with Hana and Rosa, and let me know what’s still left to fix? I’m tracking the supplies, so I’ll flag any gaps once you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll check in with Hana and Rosa, then come back with what’s still left to fix. I’ll let you know if I hear about any supply gaps too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you check my garage shelf for the box of spare screws and the cordless drill? I’ve set them near the back door.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll check by the back door and bring them over if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — that’s right by the back door and should be easy to spot. If you see the box of spare screws too, please bring both over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still waiting on who’s organizing it and the exact timing. I’ll share the details as soon as they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — I’ll keep an eye out and bring my lamp and a few broken things if I can find them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll send the organizer and timing as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning at the community center — bring any tools or spare parts you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Saturday morning at the community center. I’ll bring what I can and maybe a few spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah — that’ll help a lot. See you Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, so I’ll swing by and check the latest repair drive details, then let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that. I’m still asking around too, and I’ll tell you as soon as I hear who’s coordinating it and when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll check while I’m out and report back as soon as I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’m still good to help. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Bo — I can bring over my tools for the repair drive. Just let me know the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — I’ll check the time and get back to you ASAP.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, the repair drive — I’m still happy to help, though I may need a quick reminder of the list. Just point me to what needs doing first and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — I can start with the loose porch step, and I’ll take the faucet at Mrs. Alvarez’s after that. Just show me where to begin.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks — let’s start with the loose porch step, and I’ll help however I can. If you remind me of the next item after that, I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send you the repair drive time as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Mara — just send it over when you have it, and I’ll work around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as the time’s locked in. Thanks for being flexible around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — can you let me know if we’re still short on boxes or labels? I’m trying to keep the sorting side from getting held up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’re still short on boxes and labels, so if you can bring a few of each, that would help a lot. I’ll keep you posted if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — I’ll bring a few boxes and labels so sorting doesn’t stall. If anything else runs low, please let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair-drive list and the addresses I have by 9. If you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — that helps a lot. Once you send the list and addresses, I’ll help spread the word and see what else I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Sam — thanks for helping spread the word. I’ll send the list and addresses by 9, and I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Kira — I’ll keep it simple and have the repair list ready by 9. We’ll stick to the basic fixes on the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ll have the repair list ready by 9, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes — I’ll have the repair list ready by 9, and we’ll stick to the basic fixes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve already started spreading the word to the neighbors nearby, and I can send Hana the repair drive details too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — please send me the repair drive details, and I’ll confirm the list before we split up the work.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send the details right away so you can confirm the list, and then we can split up the work.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to confirm the repair list first, then we can divide up what’s left. What details do we have so far?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can help confirm the repair list and then share what’s left with the nearby neighbors. What details do you already have?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — so far we only have that we’re confirming the repair list first. Once you share what’s left, I can help sort out the nearby neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Faye — do you know who’s handling the repair drive details, and when we’ll get the time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mina — Hana’s checking the list and coordinating the leftovers. I’m still good to help; I just need the repair drive time so I can work around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — I’ll check with Hana and send the repair drive time as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — if you could share the repair drive details with nearby neighbors, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’ll pass along the repair drive details to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’m still on it. I’m checking the supply list and I’ll let you know what’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’ll be at Mrs. Alvarez’s place for the porch step, and I’ll keep an eye out for the faucet parts too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll sort through the supply list and send you anything we still need for Mrs. Alvarez’s place and the faucet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let the neighbors nearby know about the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. I’ll send the repair list and organizer info by 9, and include the addresses I have too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Jules — I’ll get the word out as soon as you send it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t nailed down the organizer or start time yet, but I’m still asking around and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — just keep me posted when you hear who’s organizing it and what time it starts. I’m happy to help once I know the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’m still asking around, and I’ll pass along the organizer and start time as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — once you confirm it, I’ll keep an eye out for any gaps and make sure we don’t run short on supplies again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Pia — I’ll confirm the details and let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — I’ll stay on top of it and keep checking for any missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We still need a few small fixes in the kitchen and by the front gate. I’ve got the screws and drill ready by the back door if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I can start on the kitchen fixes and then check the front gate. I’ll grab the screws and drill from the back door.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Rey — thank you. Start with the kitchen, then head to the front gate, and let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still hearing bits and pieces, but I’ll bring my old lamp and see what else I can find. Have you heard what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still nailing down the exact time, but I’ll share it as soon as I have it. I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye out for your update and bring the lamp when we know the time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center. If you can send over any tools, supplies, or volunteer names, I’ll keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll keep it simple and send over the basic repair list by 9, along with any tools or names I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Eli — that works great. I’ll keep the list updated and be ready to slot everything in when it comes over by 9.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but I’ll swing by and check the latest repair drive details, then let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just checking, you’re still on it for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — I’m still on it, and I’ll check the latest repair drive details while I’m out.
